title: Context-aware stacked convolutional neural networks for classification of breast carcinomas in whole-slide histopathology images

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Currently, histopathological tissue examination by a pathologist represents the gold standard for breast lesion diagnostics.

evidence.text: Currently, histopathological tissue examination by a pathologist represents the gold standard for breast lesion diagnostics.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Context-aware stacked convolutional neural networks for classification of breast carcinomas in whole-slide histopathology images》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Training of this stacked architecture with large input patches enables learning of fine-grained (cellular) details and global tissue structures.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Our system is trained and evaluated on a dataset containing 221 WSIs of hematoxylin and eosin stained breast tissue specimens.

evidence.text: Training of this stacked architecture with large input patches enables learning of fine-grained (cellular) details and global tissue structures.
Our system is trained and evaluated on a dataset containing 221 WSIs of hematoxylin and eosin stained breast tissue specimens.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Context-aware stacked convolutional neural networks for classification of breast carcinomas in whole-slide histopathology images》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】The system achieves an AUC of 0.962 for the binary classification of nonmalignant and malignant slides and obtains a three-class accuracy of 81.3% for classification of WSIs into normal/benign, DCIS, and IDC, demonstrating its potential for routine diagnostics.

evidence.text: The system achieves an AUC of 0.962 for the binary classification of nonmalignant and malignant slides and obtains a three-class accuracy of 81.3% for classification of WSIs into normal/benign, DCIS, and IDC, demonstrating its potential for routine diagnostics.
